service: NeuroText AI Isolated General Inference Microservice (DistilGPT-2)
benchmark_environment: Python 3.13, PyTorch 2.15 CPU, Isolated Clean Process

render_free_512mb_safety_analysis.assessment: Even in an isolated clean Python process with zero BiLSTM imports or dependencies, DistilGPT-2 reaches 704.84 MB upon first forward pass and peaks at 714.15 MB during 15-token generation. This produces a -202.15 MB deficit against Render Free's 512 MB ceiling, causing immediate OOM termination (exit 137 / SIGKILL). Safe hosting requires an instance with >=1 GB RAM (e.g. Render Starter $7/mo) or a serverless inference backend.
